purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Truck Order Generation Truck Order Preview details.
features: This feature allows the user to call ITB004 report by passing relevant parameters.
The user can select one or many bookings at a time to generate Truck Order Preview.

events.description: Calls the ITB004 report with the relevant parameters of the selected bookings and shows the Truck Order as a PDF.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon next to Truck Order Generation and selects "Truck Order Preview".
